summary: Verified the three production-bug fixes end-to-end. (1) DELIVERY FEE IN QUOTE: POST /api/checkout/quote with fulfillment=delivery and no address now returns 200 with subtotal=10, delivery_fee=1.0, total=11 for 1x Sandwich Triple; qty=3 (subtotal=30€ >= free_delivery_threshold) returns delivery_fee=0.0; pickup returns delivery_fee=0.0. (2) POST /api/checkout/session with the same delivery+no-address payload still refuses order creation (either 400 'Adresse de livraison requise' or 423 restaurant closed during test window). (3) ADMIN FORCE-RESEED: POST /api/admin/seed/reseed unauth => 403; with admin bearer => 200 {ok:true, menu_items:40, categories:9, sauces:12, burger_styles:1, burger_sizes:3, burger_meats:6, burger_cheeses:0, burger_supplements:6, settings_reset:1}. /api/menu still 40, /api/categories still 9 after reseed. FRONTEND: seeded cart via localStorage on /checkout (restaurant closed but form still renders because items>0). Clicking data-testid=fulfillment-delivery shows the 'Livraison 1,00 €' line and Total '11,00 €' in the recap panel immediately, WITHOUT any address field filled. checkout-submit stays disabled. Admin /admin/settings: red 'Zone rouge' card with data-testid=settings-force-reseed visible at the bottom; clicking it, accepting window.confirm, fires the reseed and displays toast 'Menu réinitialisé : 40 plats, 9 catégories, 12 sauces.'.

test_results.postal_code_allowlist_enforced_on_sessio: SKIPPED - restaurant closed at test time causes 423 before postal check runs. Address-check ordering (accepting_orders -> address -> postal) is correct in code (server.py:552-584); manual verification recommended during open hours.
test_results.admin_seed_reseed_auth_success: PASS (menu_items=40, categories=9, sauces=12, burger_styles=1, burger_sizes=3, burger_meats=6, burger_cheeses=0, burger_supplements=6, settings_reset=1); /api/menu still 40, /api/categories still 9 after reseed
test_results.checkout_ui_delivery_fee_line_visible: PASS - 'Livraison 1,00 €' and 'Total 11,00 €' appear immediately on delivery toggle with no address filled
test_results.admin_settings_reseed_button_click: PASS - toast 'Menu réinitialisé : 40 plats, 9 catégories, 12 sauces.' shown after confirm

critical_code_review_comments: In _quote_or_create the postal_code allowlist check is inside `if payload.fulfillment == 'delivery' and create:`, which is correct. But note: because _ensure_accepting_orders runs BEFORE the address/postal check (line 553 vs 562), any session attempted when the restaurant is closed will 423 first and never surface the 'Adresse de livraison requise' or 'postal_code_not_served' errors — this makes the postal-not-served test path unreachable outside opening hours. Consider swapping order or documenting the expected 423 short-circuit.

admin_force_reseed returns generic {ok:true, ...counts} with no idempotency token or audit-log entry. Given it wipes reference collections, an audit record (who clicked, when) in a new collection would help post-incident forensics.

SettingsAdmin uses window.confirm — accessible enough but non-testid; a shadcn AlertDialog with data-testid=settings-force-reseed-confirm would let SDET assert the confirm state without relying on dialog listeners.

success_rate.backend: 100% of runnable tests (6/6 executed passed; 1 skipped due to closed-hours 423)

seed_data_creation: No orders created. Cart seeded via localStorage bt_cart_v1 for the checkout UI test (client-side only). No DB writes from the test session other than the reseed endpoint, which is idempotent by design and left the DB in the shipped-JSON baseline.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview restaurant status at test time was 'closed' (reopening in ~4h). This blocks POST /api/checkout/session with 423 before it can reach the address / postal-code validators. To exercise the postal-code allowlist path directly, either run tests during open hours or temporarily PUT /api/settings with hours_per_day opening the current day, then restore via POST /api/admin/seed/reseed. Reusable regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_delivery_fee_and_reseed.py. The delivery-fee bug (main user-visible issue) is fully verified both server-side and in the UI recap panel.
